subject: chemistry
content: The reaction of white phosphorus on boiling with alkali in inert atmosphere resulted in the formation of product 'A'. The reaction of 1 mol of 'A' with excess of AgNO<sub>3</sub> in aqueous medium gives ___________ mol(s) of Ag. (Round off to the Nearest Integer).
